lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; the reply leaves out the dependent condition. i1040gi p. 98, Schedule 1, line 21: you can take the deduction only if "You, or your spouse if filing jointly, aren't claimed as a dependent on someone else's (such as your parent's) 2025 tax return"; the project tests it with sli.claimed_count (person.sav_claimed) in sli.eligible, and the reply's own note says it did not encode it. Triage 6e21762b3daa: 2,478/3,116 agree; all 8 value differences are returns where the filer or the spouse is claimed on another return (person.sav_claimed true: classm.sli.3, dep.sli_claimed_no_deduction, stage11.sli.claimed, stage11.sli.spouse_claimed, stage16.sd.line17_no_skips_19 and three mutation cases), where the project's 0 is right; the other 630 are candidate-refuses (522) and candidate-unknown (108) on refused or incomplete returns. The separate-return zero is the same in both.

Ruling: representation; the worksheet's line 1 (interest paid less unqualified and assisted parts, at most $2,500; i1040gi p. 98, Student Loan Interest Deduction Worksheet, line 1) is the same in both on every return the interview reaches. The project asks sli.any only on a return that is not married filing separately (sli.any_if_not_mfs; the deduction is not allowed on a separate return), the reply reads it on every return. Triage 6e21762b3daa: 3,021/3,116 agree; the 29 value differences are all separate returns (classm.tcw.4, .9, .15, classm.clcw_next_year.3, classm.retirement.4.deepseek, mutation.t2.f8962_months_r4 and others) whose fixtures still carry an sli.any answer the interview no longer asks; the deduction is 0 on them in both; the rest are 40 project-refuses (Pub. 970 exception), 13 project-unknown, 13 candidate-unknown.

Ruling: representation; project retained. The worksheet gives no amount for married filing separately, which cannot take the deduction; the project enters zero there and the second enters $85,000. Neither reaches Schedule 1 line 21: sli.deduction is zero for married filing separately.
Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Line 6 is used only when line 4 is more than line 5 (line 8 skips it otherwise), where the signed difference and the floored one are the same.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. The project skips to zero when line 4 is not more than line 5, as the worksheet says; the second always applies the ratio, which then has a part of zero or less, and prorate keeps the ratio at 0 or more, so it also gives zero (the same argument as the classified mutant on sli.line8).
